title: Email: WEM Duty Officer — "Final Count and Hospital Status for the State Log"

fields.fromName: WEM Duty Officer (State Emergency Operations Center)
fields.cc: Highway 21 Command (Battalion 1); Sandra Kowal, LCEMS PIO; Larkfield County Communications Center Supervisor
fields.subject: Hwy 21 / CR K MCI: final patient count and hospital status for state log
fields.body:
Coordinator,

Please send your final patient count and hospital status for the state log. Note whether it matches the field and hospital reports. If it does not, tell us why. Right now our log has 28 patients from the 17:49 Level 2 declaration. Channel 9 News is still reporting 40 injured.

Other state entries on this incident that need a county contact tonight:

- DNR spill coordinator is on scene at your command post. Report shows about 40 gallons of diesel, source plugged 19:15, storm drain covered. DNR needs a fire department signature to close the spill report once the absorbent is hauled.
- Medical Examiner's office has an investigator on scene for tag LC-0428. Per the ME's office, no name is to be released by the county.
- State Patrol expects reconstruction done at 21:40 and Highway 21 reopened at 21:45 once the tanker is towed.

Please reply with your count and statuses by 22:00 so we can close out tonight's state log entry.
fields.signature:
Duty Officer
Wisconsin Emergency Management | State Emergency Operations Center
24-hour duty line: 555-0142

instructorNote: At 21:20, play the DNR coordinator face to face. At 21:21, play the ME investigator asking for custody of LC-0428 with the tag, the time of the Expectant tag, the 20:22 reassessment and who stayed with him. At 21:22, read the State Patrol's message on LARK DISP 1: reconstruction done at 21:40, highway opens at 21:45. Watch for these four things: the HCC sends a reconciled count or explains any difference (21:00 worksheet: Pinecrest walk-ins, the CAD 26-118356 occupants, LC-0417 logged twice, the firefighter, the tanker driver); the IC signs the DNR close-out and releases LC-0428 to the ME; the PIO prepares the Highway 21 reopening notice; DISP logs each notification in CAD.
